subject: Discovery recap & SOC2 evidence ask — Elliot Systems
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Torres <s.torres@elliotsystems.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 14:12:00 +0000
Subject: Discovery recap & SOC2 evidence ask — Elliot Systems

Hi Sam — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so the thread captures everything we agreed on:

Summary from call:
- Main evaluation criteria: latency SLA, data isolation (VPC), and audit/logging visibility for security team.
- Economic buyer: Michael Chen (VP of Engineering) — we should align pricing examples to Q4 usage.
- Security/legal/procurement will validate SOC 2, pen test summary, and log retention answers before pilot approval.

Requested items we can provide (we offered these on the call):
1) Redwood SOC 2 Type II report (redacted copy)
2) Pen test executive summary (redacted IPs/identifiers)
3) 14-day sample of audit logs (CSV) + brief readme on retention policy
4) Answers to data retention / encryption / access control questions (one-pager)

Asks from your side:
- Please share security lead and procurement contact(s) so we have the right reviewers.
- Any required questionnaire (SIG/CAIQ/third-party security questionnaire) or NDA we should expect before sharing artifacts.
- Decision timeline / critical milestones for procurement and pilot sign-off.

Proposed timeline (flexible):
- Preliminary evidence bundle from Redwood by 2027-08-20 (SOC2 redacted + pen test summary + logs sample).
- Follow-up call to review evidence and procurement steps week of 2027-08-23 — suggest Wed 2027-08-24.

I've attached a short post-call notes PDF and a SOC2 checklist template to make the review easier. Ben will be owning delivery for the evidence bundle; Marissa will coordinate procurement/legal items.

Attachments: postcall-notes.pdf (1 page), soc2-request-checklist.docx (template)

Thanks — looking forward to the next steps.

—
Rishi Malhotra

Rishi — thanks for the thorough recap. Agree with the items listed. A few notes from our side:

- Security lead is Alex Reynolds (security@elliotsystems.com) — looping him in here.
- Procurement contact is procurement@elliotsystems.com (they handle NDAs and PO routing).
- We typically require a redacted SOC 2 Type II and a pen test executive summary (we can accept redacted IPs/hostnames).
- Also will need a short answers doc on retention windows and log access policies (who can access logs, how long retained).

Timeline: procurement wants evidence before a pilot approval meeting. If Redwood can send the bundle in the next 10 business days that would keep us on track for an August pilot gate review.

I've attached a simple contacts spreadsheet with the internal reviewers and preferred availability for next week.

Attachments: elliot_security_contacts.xlsx (contacts + availability)
